candidates.text: ALSO PURSUANT TO RULE 42 I REMIND ALL IN THIS CHAMBER THAT NO DEMONSTRATION OF APPROVAL OR DISAPPROVAL FROM MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC WILL BE PERMITTED.

WE'RE NOW ON TO THE FIRST ORDER OF BUSINESS WHICH IS THE APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES FROM THE MEETING OF OCTOBER 7TH, 2026.
THE MINUTES OF THE OCTOBER 7TH MEETING ARE APPROVED.

COUNCILOR SANTANA, THE CHAIR OF THE COMMITTEE ON PUBLIC SAFETY AND CRIMINAL JUSTICE SEEKS SUSPENSION OF THE RULES AND CONFIRMATION OF DOCKET 1954 .
BUT IT WAS GREAT TO HEAR THEIR PERSONAL SIDE AND WHAT THEY BRING TO THEIR NEIGHBORHOODS, THEIR COMMUNITY AND JUST LOOKING FORWARD TO APPROVING AND VOTING IN FAVOR TODAY.

WE HAVE SOME LIMITED OVERSIGHT OF THE ZBA AND THAT LIMITED OVERSIGHT OF THE ZBA IS THE INTERACTION IN ENGAGE AND ENGAGEMENT WE HAVE WITH NOMINEES BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL BEFORE THE VOTE AND ON I WOULD ENCOURAGE MY CITY C

ALL IN FAVOR SAY I ALL OPPOSED .
